mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_stock_log (sku_id, order_no, type, change_qty, before_qty, after_qty, operator, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{skuId}, #{orderNo}, #{type}, #{changeQty}, #{beforeQty}, #{afterQty}, #{operator}, #{remark}, NOW())
